rows.grounds: numeral element qualifying the following thousands
locative plural indicating the vast number
compound denoting devices or realms of birth
describes beings subjected to suffering in those realms

items.question: What condition afflicts beings within the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms?
premises: Beings are located within these womb-mechanisms.
These beings are described as tormented.
items.inference: Beings situated in the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms are subject to torment.
uncertainties: The implied subject of pīḍitāḥ is not explicitly stated in this verse and is inferred from context.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
